Tree & Vegetation Cutting Application in the Protected Shoreland

 The Newbury Conservation Commission has updated the process for requesting and submitting a Tree & Vegetation Cutting Application In the Protected Shoreland District. You can now download the application from this website by clicking on the link: Tree & Vegetation Cutting Application in the Protected Shoreland Overlay District. Complete the application, scan the application and email it to the Newbury Conservation Commission. 

The application will be reviewed by the Conservation Commission and you will be contacted if any additional information is needed. Please click the following links to the email addresses to the Code Enforcement Officer and the Conservation Commission to send the completed application  The completed application can still be delivered to the Newbury Town Office, please place the application in the Conservation Commission box on the table outside the Code Enforcement Officer's Office.
